templates.blankHint: Name your own first queue and service.

descriptions.barber: A walk-in queue with Haircut and Beard services and three chairs.
descriptions.clinic: Ticket numbers only, generic Appointment and Walk-in services and two rooms.
descriptions.restaurant: A waitlist with a table service and three tables.

templates.applyIntro: Adds queues, services and counters in one step. Anything with the same name is kept. Only possible before today's first guest.

live.title: {{name}} is ready for its first guest.
live.intro: Guests scan the code or open the link and join. Share it now and finish setup at your own pace.
live.tryIt: Scan this with your phone, join, then call yourself from the console.
live.hoursHint: Until you set hours, your line accepts guests at any time of day.
live.teamHint: Staff call the next guest from their own phone.
live.tv: Pair a TV in your waiting room
live.tvHint: Show who is being called. Optional.

alerts.title: How guests know it's their turn
alerts.phone: Guests see their place in line on their phone and it updates by itself.
alerts.browser: They get a browser alert when you call them. On iPhone they must first tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
alerts.tv: A TV in your waiting room shows the number being called.
alerts.textsFree: Text messages are not sent on your current plan. They come with a paid plan.
alerts.textsPaid: Your plan can also send text messages to guests who share a phone number and agree to texts.
